security_audit.summary: Five findings confirm intended OpenHue command execution, and the homepage URL is a benign, low-severity network reference. Five backtick findings are Markdown false positives; review also found device-state changes without required confirmation.

remediation.issue: State-changing examples do not require user confirmation before controlling physical lights.
remediation.suggestion: Require confirmation before executing off commands, room-wide changes, scene activation, or other actions affecting multiple devices.

content.user_title: Control Philips Hue Lights with OpenHue
content.value_statement: Managing Hue lights manually can interrupt daily routines and focused work. This skill translates clear requests into OpenHue CLI actions for lights, rooms, and scenes.
actual_capabilities: Lists available Hue lights, rooms, and scenes.
Turns individual lights or entire rooms on and off.
Sets brightness from zero to 100 percent.
Adjusts supported lights by color name, RGB value, or color temperature.
Activates named scenes within a selected room.
Applies multi-setting presets for bedtime, work, or movie viewing.
limitations: Requires the OpenHue CLI and a reachable Philips Hue Bridge on the local network.
First-time bridge pairing requires a physical button press.
Color settings work only with color-capable Hue bulbs.
Does not control non-Hue devices, HomeKit automations, televisions, or HVAC systems.

use_cases.title: Adjust Everyday Lighting
use_cases.description: Control a named lamp or room without opening the Hue application.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Focused Workspace
use_cases.description: Set office brightness and temperature for focused work sessions.

use_cases.title: Activate Accessible Lighting
use_cases.description: Use natural-language requests to control lights when manual switches are difficult to reach.

prompt_templates.title: List Hue Resources
prompt_templates.prompt: List all Hue lights, rooms, and scenes available through OpenHue. Do not change any device.

prompt_templates.title: Set One Light
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn on [light name] and set its brightness to [percentage]. Confirm the target and setting before execution.

prompt_templates.title: Activate a Room Scene
prompt_templates.prompt: Activate the [scene name] scene in [room name]. Verify that both resources exist and ask for confirmation before execution.
prompt_templates.scenario: Apply a saved scene to one room.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate Multiple Rooms
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect available resources, then propose settings for [rooms] based on [activity]. Show every planned change and execute only after confirmation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Plan an advanced, multi-room lighting change.

output_examples.input: Turn on Bedroom Lamp at 50 percent brightness.
output_examples.output: Bedroom Lamp is on at 50 percent brightness.

output_examples.input: Set the Relax scene in the bedroom.
output_examples.output: The Relax scene is active in Bedroom.

output_examples.input: What lights and rooms are available?
output: Lights: Bedroom Lamp, Desk Lamp, Hall Light

best_practices: List resources first when device, room, or scene names are uncertain.
Confirm room-wide and multi-device changes before execution.
Use brightness, temperature, and color values supported by the target bulbs.
anti_patterns: Do not guess light, room, or scene names.
Do not use this skill for devices outside the Philips Hue ecosystem.
Do not repeatedly retry commands when the bridge is unreachable or pairing is incomplete.

faq.question: What must be installed before using this skill?
faq.answer: Install the OpenHue CLI and ensure the Hue Bridge is reachable on the local network.

faq.question: Does first-time setup require physical access?
faq.answer: Yes. Initial pairing requires pressing the button on the Hue Bridge.

faq.question: Can it control an entire room?
faq.answer: Yes. It can change room power and brightness through OpenHue.

faq.question: Can it activate saved Hue scenes?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the scene name and its target room.

faq.question: Can every Hue bulb display colors?
faq.answer: No. Color commands require a color-capable bulb, while white-only bulbs support fewer settings.

faq.question: Does it support other smart-home brands?
faq.answer: No. The skill is limited to resources exposed through a Philips Hue Bridge.
